scope: Execution integration reporting and settings concurrency review fixes
changes: Status inspects current local recovery journals and distinguishes an active owner lease.
Recovery-required command outcomes count as unresolved and retain bounded execution provenance in recovery context.
General settings merge only their allowed fields into the current record under the shared admission lock, retaining a concurrent Docker image selection.
Status reports observed logical storage bytes and entries with complete/error/time/scope metadata under a 750 ms scan deadline.
UI explicitly describes the 2 GiB/100000-entry monitor as soft and excludes Docker images/VM allocation.
limits: No inference or pilot workspace access.
Storage scan is non-atomic and reports logical sizes, not allocated disk blocks; incomplete scans are labeled.
No automatic pruning or runtime installation.
developmentAttempt: phase2-integration-review-fixture-attempt.jsonl preserves two fixture setup failures corrected before final regression.
